csv_project_name: Developer Service Riverfront Site at S 18th & Riverside Mews
csv_scope_of_work: The Urban Redevelopment Authority of Pittsburgh (the URA ) is seeking developers and/or development teams (each a Redeveloper or Respondent ) to submit a proposal for the purchase and redevelopment of the Riverside Mews site (the Property ) located at 9 15 S 18th Street and 1806 1830 S Riverside Mews (Block 12-A, Lots 7 and 11) in the South Side Flats neighborhood of the City of Pittsburgh. The goal of this Request for Proposals (RFP) is to select a qualified and economically viable development proposal for the redevelopment of the Property.

title: Developer Service Riverfront Site at South 18th & Riverside Mews
short_description: Developer sought for purchase and redevelopment of a riverfront site in Pittsburgh.
project_location: 9-15 S 18th Street and 1806-1830 S Riverside Mews, South Side Flats, Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, USA
project_scope: Redevelopment of the Riverside Mews property, identified as Block 12-A, Lots 7 and 11, for purchase and redevelopment by a qualified development team. The notice concerns a riverfront site in the South Side Flats neighborhood of Pittsburgh, but no technical building program, gross floor area, structural system, or dimensions are stated.
services: Developer/design-build services for acquisition and redevelopment proposal preparation; no specific structural or engineering planning scope is defined.
relevance_explanation:
- This is primarily a developer solicitation for site purchase and redevelopment, not a defined structural engineering tender.
- No bridge, long-span roof, special structure, stadium, or technically demanding building scope is described.
- No explicit planning services for structural design, bridge engineering, or HOAI-equivalent phases are requested.
- Could offer indirect teaming potential with developers, but the current notice is too unspecific for sbp's core profile.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget or estimated development cost is stated in the notice. Available information useful for later estimation: riverfront redevelopment site at 9-15 S 18th Street and 1806-1830 S Riverside Mews in Pittsburgh; no area, program, height, or technical specifications provided.
fee_explanation: No design fee or engineering fee information is provided. Because the project scope, building program, and required engineering services are undefined, no realistic sbp fee estimate is possible from the notice alone.
references_qualifications: Qualified and economically viable development proposal required from developers and/or development teams; no specific engineering references or technical qualification thresholds are stated.
award_criteria: Selection of a qualified and economically viable development proposal; detailed weighting criteria are not stated in the notice excerpt.
